explanation: Job 2 fails to preserve upstream provenance ranks in the priority records. Its output assigns upstream_rank 0 to every priority, even though the supplied evidence_sources contain ranks 1 through 8. The source code evidence localizes this to prioritize: it builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources.record_id values, which are source identities s01-s08, then looks up coverage record_id values n06-r01-n06-r08, so every lookup falls back to 0.
cited_evidence: Job 2 input evidence_sources include ranked provenance records: s01 rank 1 through s08 rank 8.
Observed Job 2 priorities all contain upstream_rank: 0 for records n06-r01 through n06-r08.

downstream_coverage_priority.py prioritize builds rank_by_record_id[evidence.get("record_id", "")] and then reads rank_by_record_id.get(coverage.get("record_id", ""), 0), but coverage record_id values are need ids while evidence record_id values are source ids.
